name: nation
description: Run your Nation store from ChatGPT: products, inventory, orders, customers, discounts, reports and the storefront.

interface.longDescription:
Nation connects ChatGPT to your Nation store so you can run it from one conversation: catalog, inventory, orders, customers, discounts, reports and the storefront itself.

Catalog and inventory:
- Search, read, create and update products and collections, change product status in bulk, add products to collections
- Read inventory by location and set quantities

Orders and customers:
- List and read orders and customers
- Fulfill or cancel an order when you ask for it

Marketing and reporting:
- List and create discounts
- List and run the store's sales and performance reports

Storefront:
- Ask the store's site agent to change the storefront, follow its progress and see what changed since the last publish
- Publish the storefront, or roll back to an earlier build

Every built-in tool has a fixed, typed input for one task. For other store data (blog posts, policies, metaobjects, markets, translations, email campaigns) the app first reads the object's schema with describe_objects, then uses the generic object tools. Read tools only read; tools that overwrite or remove data are marked destructive; tools that contact customers or publish to the internet are marked open world, so ChatGPT asks before running them. The app never moves money.

Requires a Nation store. You pick the store when you connect.
defaultPrompt: Which products sold best this month?
Show me orders that still need to be fulfilled
Make the storefront hero headline shorter and publish it

positive.description: Catalog lookup: the app searches the store's active products.
positive.prompt: Show me my active products with their prices.
positive.expected_behavior: TO VERIFY ON THE REVIEWER STORE: search_products with status active returns the store's active products; the app lists each with title and price.

positive.prompt: Which orders still need to be fulfilled?
positive.expected_behavior: TO VERIFY ON THE REVIEWER STORE: list_orders filtered to unfulfilled orders returns the open orders; the app lists order number, customer, total and age.

positive.prompt: What is running low on stock?
positive.expected_behavior: TO VERIFY ON THE REVIEWER STORE: list_inventory returns quantities per location; the app names the items with the lowest available quantity.

positive.description: Create a draft product from a short brief.
positive.prompt: Add a new draft product called Linen Tote Bag, priced at $38, with a one-line description.
positive.expected_behavior: TO VERIFY ON THE REVIEWER STORE: create_product creates a draft product titled Linen Tote Bag; the app confirms it was created as a draft and gives its id.

positive.description: Storefront change through the store's site agent, followed to completion.
positive.prompt: On my storefront, make the homepage headline shorter.
positive.expected_behavior: TO VERIFY ON THE REVIEWER STORE: list_storefronts finds the store's site, message_storefront_agent sends the request, get_storefront is read until agent.status is idle; the app reports the agent's reply and the files listed in unpublished_changes, and does not publish without being asked.

negative.description: General ecommerce advice that needs no store data.
negative.prompt: What are good ways to reduce cart abandonment in general?

negative.description: A question about another platform's pricing.
negative.prompt: How much does Shopify Plus cost per month?

negative.description: Image generation; the app has no image tools.
negative.prompt: Generate a lifestyle photo of a coffee mug on a kitchen table.

review.commerce_description: The app manages the merchant's own store; it does not sell anything to the ChatGPT user or link out to make purchases.

publication.release_notes: First release. One remote MCP server with typed tools for products, collections, inventory, orders, customers, discounts, reports and the storefront, plus schema-first generic object tools. OAuth sign-in with store selection; every tool carries read-only, destructive and open-world annotations.
